title: A failing summary is never retried back to back on the same provider
replays: The 2 Nov 2026 class: the fold to mistral-large-4-0 answered with no summary three times, 31.6 s apart on the same host and model, and the third failure paused summaries. Replayed offline on a hosted instance: owner turns past the fold trigger, a quiet evening, and every fold answer empty. A cycle may walk its rungs once each; it never asks one host and model twice, and it never pauses or asks the owner for /compact.
